name: Star Trails
description: Arcs of light wheel round a pole below the sheet, the long exposure of a night sky, each trail a different length and brightness.

code.style: --rule: ( --w: @calc(1.8 / sqrt((@dx - 0) * (@dx - 0) + (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6)) * (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6))))%; --m1: @calc(50 + @r(-0.45, 0.45) * 50 / sqrt((@dx - 0) * (@dx - 0) + (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6)) * (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6))))%; --m2: @calc(50 + @r(-0.45, 0.45) * 50 / sqrt((@dx - 0) * (@dx - 0) + (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6)) * (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6))))%; --l1: @calc(@r(0.7, 2.2) / max(sqrt((@dx - 0) * (@dx - 0) + (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6)) * (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6))), 0.6) * 57.3)deg; --l2: @calc(@r(0.5, 1.6) / max(sqrt((@dx - 0) * (@dx - 0) + (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6)) * (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6))), 0.6) * 57.3)deg; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -150%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); mask: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc(sqrt((@dx - 0) * (@dx - 0) + (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6)) * (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6))) * 50)% @calc(sqrt((@dx - 0) * (@dx - 0) + (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6)) * (@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6))) * 50)% at @calc(50 + (0 - @dx) * 25)% @calc(50 + ((@Y / 2 + 0.6) - @dy) * 25)%, transparent calc(@var(--m1) - @var(--w)), #000 0 calc(@var(--m1) + @var(--w)), transparent 0), conic-gradient(from calc(@calc((atan2((@dy - (@Y / 2 + 0.6)), (@dx - 0)) * 180 / PI + 90))deg - @var(--l1) / 2) at @calc(50 + (0 - @dx) * 25)% @calc(50 + ((@Y / 2 + 0.6) - @dy) * 25)%, #000 0 @var(--l1), transparent 0); mask-composite: intersect; opacity: @r(0.55, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -150%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); mask-composite: intersect; opacity: @r(0.4, 0.9); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
